findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed the bar hand washing sink is not sealed to the wall. Ensure that the hand washing sink is sealed to the wall (ex. caulking) to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface by the next routine inspection. 

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed there is not cove base along the wall in the ware washing room behind the triple sink and ice machine. There are several cracks along the wall seam that are accumulating dirt and other debris. Ensure that there is cove base present by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
Ice in the ice bin is heavily soiled by white/clear slime mold. The ice has a frosted appearance. The ice bin is covered in mold and residue. Due to imminent health concerns of using the ice, the ice machine MAY NOT BE USED until approval is granted by SCDPH inspector. The ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized fully before it may be used to produce ice. Ice may be purchased from an approved source in the meantime. Inspector will return on Wednesday 11/22/2023 if not contacted beforehand to inspect the ice machine.

3-101.11: FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, honestly presented.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The freezing tray, baffles, and drain lines of the ice machine are heavily soiled with mold and residue. All areas of the ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized. All food contact surfaces must be cleaned and sanitized. All food-contact surfaces must remain clean to sight and touch and be sanitized often enough to prevent ANY mold growth. Inspector will return on 11/22/2023 to evaluate compliance with these requirements at that time.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Base coving is missing along the wall near the ice machine and drain. These areas must be sealed to be smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable. Ensure that all surfaces subject to food/water are made smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable by the next routine inspection. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Observed boxes of prepackaged snacks to be stored on the floor in the back storage area. Provide shelving for snack storage. 
3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.
